canonical_data: uploaded and connected sources chunked into a vector store the operator selects, with users, agents, conversations, and memory-tool files in a relational database
current_repo_note: Not open core: the governance features the vendor's enterprise tier lists — role management, single sign-on with provisioning, teams, and connectors — are all in the permissive tree, and the paid tiers are hosting and support. The recommended quick-start path routes inference through the vendor's public endpoint with a shared key, and version checks contact the vendor unless disabled.
strengths: The governance features a competitor sells as enterprise — role management, single sign-on with provisioning, and teams — are in the permissive tree and documented
Agents are first-class integration surfaces: any compatible client or tool-server host can call a configured agent
A real correctness gate, with thousands of tests run on every push and coverage reported
weaknesses: The default quick-start routes all inference through the vendor's public endpoint with a shared key
Version checks contact the vendor by default
The memory tool and lifecycle are thin, with path-keyed overwrite and no consolidation or temporal handling, and graph retrieval is gated to one store
why_it_matters: A complete permissively licensed knowledge platform whose enterprise governance is not withheld, and which turns each knowledge agent into an endpoint other software can call.
